name: io.github.softglazee/softglaze-browser-mcp
title: SoftGlaze Browser
description: Manage SoftGlaze Browser profiles, proxies and macros on your PC. Every change asks you first.

environmentVariables.name: SOFTGLAZE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SoftGlaze AI token (sgai_...) from the SoftGlaze AI page, Tokens tab, in SoftGlaze Browser 1.0.22 or newer.

environmentVariables.name: SOFTGLAZE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port shown on the SoftGlaze AI page (8080 unless the Owner changed it).
